notes: What's New in 0.1.3: Production Runner 0.1.3 gives Shots a cleaner, easier-to-read look and adds optional crash reports, so we can find and fix problems faster. Home, Script (with Cast ID), Shots, the Scheduler, Contacts, Locations and Tasks work as before.

Shots: a cleaner shot list: Every shot is now a calm strip of the same height. The shot number and what happens come first, with who's in it underneath; framing, time and status sit in their own columns. The scene colour is a thin edge instead of a full fill, so the colour key is gone. By scene and By shoot day both use the new look, and each shoot day shows its call time and how long lighting and rolling take.

Shots: a clearer shot panel: The panel on the right shows the frame with its size, angle, movement and lens in plain words, What happens in its own box, the framing as a two-column grid with the setup's shared lighting time, the status track, priority (Must have, Should or If time), Sync or MOS, and who's in it.

Crash and error reports: When the app crashes or something goes wrong, it can send us a report so we can fix it. The first time you open 0.1.3 it asks you once, and nothing is sent before you answer. Reports are about the app, never your work: no scripts, productions, contacts, photos, files, email address or name. Change your answer any time in Settings ▸ Privacy.

Report a Problem: Send: With crash and error reports on, Help ▸ Report a Problem or Send Feedback has a Send button: your note goes straight to us with the app version and your system, linked to your account ID, never the production's name. Email still works too. Settings ▸ About shows your Support ID to quote if you write to us.

To install: Open Download Page downloads the update in your browser. Open the downloaded file, drag Production Runner onto Applications and choose Replace. Your productions are kept. From this version on, updates install inside the app.
